text: Trumpet the alarm on my holy mountain! Shake the country up! God's Judgment's on its way—the Day's almost here!
Clouds with no silver lining! Like dawn light moving over the mountains, a huge army is coming. There's never been anything like it and never will be again.
and fire licks up everything in its wake. Before it arrives, the country is like the Garden of Eden. When it leaves, it is Death Valley. Nothing escapes unscathed.

Each one knows his job and does it. Undaunted and fearless, unswerving, unstoppable.

God's personal Message!— "Come back to me and really mean it! Come fasting and weeping, sorry for your sins!"
Come back to God, your God. And here's why: God is kind and merciful. He takes a deep breath, puts up with a lot, This most patient God, extravagant in love, always ready to cancel catastrophe.
maybe he'll turn around and show pity. Maybe, when all's said and done, there'll be blessings full and robust for your God!
Declare a day of repentance, a holy fast day. Call a public meeting.
Make sure the elders come, but bring in the children, too, even the nursing babies, Even men and women on their honeymoon— interrupt them and get them there.

let the priests, God's servants, weep tears of repentance. Let them intercede: "Have mercy, God, on your people! Don't abandon your heritage to contempt. Don't let the pagans take over and rule them and sneer, 'And so where is this God of theirs?' "
He took pity on his people.
"Look, listen—I'm sending a gift: Grain and wine and olive oil. The fast is over—eat your fill! I won't expose you any longer to contempt among the pagans.

God has done great things.
The fields and meadows are greening up. The trees are bearing fruit again: a bumper crop of fig trees and vines!
Be glad in your God. He's giving you a teacher to train you how to live right— Teaching, like rain out of heaven, showers of words to refresh and nourish your soul, just as he used to do.
